title: GUNS ARE RARER IN LOOT
why: His order of 2026-10-15: there are too many guns in the loot and getting a gun needs to be rarer. Every gun row in the container and body loot tables (lockers, safes, bodies, caches, the jackpot) now pays about half as often. It is done without an extra random draw: a roll that landed in the second half of a gun row is read again through the ordinary rows of the same table, so every non-gun result is exactly what it was and the same seed still builds the same containers. Crates, which hold no guns, are untouched.
now: Guns are about half as common in boxes and on bodies.
